desc:
Keynote 2, Hot Chips 2023, Tuesday, August 29, 2023

Bill Dally, NVIDIA

Bill describes many of the challenges of building hardware optimized for Deep Learning and how NVIDIA in particular is addressing these challenges, particularly for training workloads.  He looks at the history of how GPUs have been modified and enhanced to make them more applicable for machine learning.

recs.stt: Nvidia, one of tech's hottest companies, is fine with remote work
recs.x:
Bill Daly gave a great presentation at Hot Chips a few weeks ago that explains how Nvidia’s AI performance was only in small parts due to process improvement. The rest was doing things smarter: matrix sparsity, different number representations and so forth.

 doing neuromorphic computing and they claim there is something 
 magical about it because it's the way that the brain works ... but 
 it's truly more like building an airplane by putting feathers on it 
 and flapping with the wings!"
